olga_csm: FYI — LuminaCare submitted an onboarding intake. They want a 13B reranker (low latency) + 70B longform summarizer for clinical support transcripts. Requirements: EU-west residency, AWS CloudHSM, strict PHI handling, and a pre-renewal report (month 4) tied to NPS + churn score. Need intake owner.
nate_ml: Quick checks — reranker 13B int8 should be fine. 70B summarizer will need quant/flash-attn and likely multi-GPU. Do they want artifacts in customer storage?
paul_customer: (customer) Confirming artifacts in our S3, HSM for key wrapping, and we require zero retention of raw transcripts. Also want cost per 1k requests estimated before renewal.
claire_security: Security items: CloudHSM integration + customer-managed KMS, no plaintext request logs, hashed request IDs only, automated deletion SLA after 24h, and signed model artifacts. Also request legal addendum for PHI.
devex_sam: I'll draft a one-page runbook and quickstart SDK. Request their eval set (50 labeled transcripts) and safety labels. Propose 30-min tech walkthrough after infra access.
nate_ml: Action items: - bench 13B reranker int8 at 128 tokens for p50 target <200ms - prototype 70B summarizer quantized fallback and measure p95 - design routing: reranker fast path, summarizer batched/streaming path - canary plan: start at 10 qps reranker / 2 summarizer for 48h
claire_security: Also add optional client-side de-id pipeline. If we run redaction in their VPC, require attestation and delete-after-processing.
deploy-bot: Onboarding ticket created: checklist -> [infra creds, HSM keys, artifact access, canary config, dashboards]. See /ops/onboard/3170000000
olga_csm: Proposed timeline: sec/legal signoff by day 2, infra + HSM by day 7, bench + prototype by day 11, canary day 13. Owners: @nate_ml benches, @devex_sam runbook, @claire_security PHI signoff, @olga_csm customer comms.
paul_customer: Thanks — we'll share eval set and AWS principal for HSM access today. Also please include a short appendix in the pre-renewal report that maps latency/cost to churn risk so our CFO can see tradeoffs.
nate_ml: Noted — I'll include churn-impact scenarios and cost per 1k in the canary report. If p95 exceeds targets we'll flag high renewal risk and propose capacity or Dedicated commit.
olga_csm: Great. Scheduling kickoff 09:30 CET tomorrow. I'll update thread after the call. :calendar:
